scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Hm? You're... What is it about you? I've been an honorable Knight for a long time, but I cannot understand this feeling I'm getting from you...
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
嗯？你是...
你身上究竟有什麼特別之處？
我當了這麼多年光榮的騎士，卻說不清從你身上感受到的這種氣息...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, a member of our Chivalry.
I hope you are living up to my expectations. We have vowed to be strong for our kingdom, even if death is upon us...
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
啊，是我們騎士團的成員。
希望你沒有辜負我的期望。
我們曾立誓，為王國堅強奮戰，縱然死亡降臨，也絕不退縮...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome,
this is the
Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
歡迎，這裡是普隆德拉騎士團。
你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome. We, the proud Knights of the Prontera Chivalry, will give our lives for king and country! Please enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
歡迎。
我們是引以為榮的普隆德拉騎士團，願為國王與國家獻出生命！
請隨意參觀。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome, this is
the Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
歡迎，這裡是普隆德拉騎士團。
你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Mmm?
{0},
what can I do for you?
Ah, you don't know
who to visit?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
嗯？
{0}，有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？
啊，你不知道該找誰？

scripts.text: [Captain Herman]
scripts.translation: [團長 赫爾曼]

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Finish the last test.
Once that is complete, all the Knights involved in your testing shall gather, and we will evaluate your performance.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
去完成最後一項考驗吧。
完成後，負責考驗你的騎士們會齊聚一堂，評議你的表現。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return once you have distributed all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
哦...！
技能點還沒用完，就不能轉職。
把技能點全部分配好，再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh, have you completed all the tests? But not everyone who completes the tests can
become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
哦，所有考驗都完成了？
不過，並不是完成考驗就一定能成為騎士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
May god bless your body and soul, warrior. I hope you will show your courage and protect those who are weaker than you.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
戰士，願上帝保佑你的身心。
希望你展現勇氣，保護比你弱小的人。

scripts.text: I want to change my job to Swordman.
scripts.translation: 我想轉職為劍士

scripts.text: I want to change my job to a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想轉職為騎士

scripts.text: Just visiting.
scripts.translation: 只是來看看

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
A-ha~
A Swordman, you say?
I'm sorry, {0}, but you've
come to the wrong place!
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
啊哈~
你說，想當劍士？
抱歉，{0}，你來錯地方了！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
This isn't the Swordsman guild, it's the Prontera Chivalry! If you wish to become a Swordman, visit the Swordman Guild located in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
這裡是普隆德拉騎士團，不是劍士公會！
想當劍士，請去依斯魯得島的劍士公會。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, I see that you have great ambition. But you must first become a Swordman before becoming
a Knight. One step at a time...
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
啊，看來你很有志向。
不過，想當騎士，得先成為劍士。
一步一步來...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First, visit the Swordman guild in Izlude. Then, come visit us again once you have become a well experienced Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
先去依斯魯得島的劍士公會吧。
等成為經驗豐富的劍士，再來找我們。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Aha~
You must have lots of free time. Why don't you go hunt some monsters instead of wandering about aimlessly?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
啊哈~
看來你挺閒的。
與其漫無目的地閒逛，不如去討伐些魔物？

scripts.text:
Welcome, this is
the Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
歡迎，這裡是普隆德拉騎士團。
請問有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: I want to change my job to a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想轉職為騎士

scripts.text: Just visiting.
scripts.translation: 只是來看看

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ohh...
A young {0} who wishes
to become a Knight!
Our Prontera Chivalry
will assist you.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
哦...
想當騎士的年輕{0}！
我們普隆德拉騎士團會幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First of all, I am the captain of the Prontera Chivalry, Herman Phon Efesirsus. I'm pleased to meet young people eager to join the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
先自我介紹一下，我是普隆德拉騎士團團長，赫爾曼·馮·艾菲西斯。
很高興見到有志加入騎士團的年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
We only accept Swordmen
who are at least Job Level 40.
We cannot consider applicants that are not yet experienced enough to become Knights.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
我們只接受職業等級達到40級的劍士。
經驗不足，還不具備成為騎士的資格，就無法受理申請。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Once you apply, and we find
you eligible, we will begin the job change procedure. Would you
like to apply now?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
提交申請後，只要確認你符合條件，就會開始轉職流程。
現在要申請嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I would like to apply.
scripts.translation: 是的，我要申請

scripts.text: I'd like to think about it please.
scripts.translation: 讓我再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, you are not yet ready to become a Knight! Didn't I specifically mention the Job Level 40 requirement?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
啊，你還不具備當騎士的資格！
我不是特意說過，職業等級要達到40級嗎？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return when you have used
all of your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
啊...！
技能點還沒用完，就不能轉職。
把技能點全部用完再回來。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Let me see...
Your name is
{0}...
Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
讓我看看...
你的名字是{0}...對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Of course I understand your strong desire to join us, but now is not the time. Go out and fight some more monsters. We will be here waiting.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
我理解你急切地想加入我們，但現在還不是時候。
去多討伐些魔物吧，我們會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Let me explain the job change procedure. You must visit a series of Knights and pass each
of their tests.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
我來說明一下轉職流程。
你需要逐一拜訪幾位騎士，通過他們各自的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Once all the tests are completed, every Knight involved in your testing will gather and discuss your performance.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
完成全部考驗後，負責考驗你的騎士們會齊聚一堂，評議你的表現。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
The Knights must unanimously approve of you before you can join the Prontera Chivalry. If only one person objects, you must
start over.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
必須得到所有騎士的一致認可，才能加入普隆德拉騎士團。
哪怕只有一人反對，也得從頭再來。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
But I believe if you persist with an earnest heart, you shall be acknowledged by the Knights and ultimately recognized as a member of our Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
不過，我相信，只要你懷著誠心堅持到底，必能獲得騎士們的認可，成為我們騎士團的一員。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
So, let's not waste any more time talking! Go and meet these Knights and begin their tests. Once you have completed all of the tests, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
好了，不再多說，去拜訪那些騎士，開始考驗吧！
全部完成後，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...!
Well, I don't want to pressure you. Take your time and think it over. Return when you are ready to
change jobs, for we will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
哦...！
我不想給你壓力，慢慢考慮吧。
準備好轉職後再來，我們會等著你。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Come to think of it, aren't you a Swordman? It looks like you've encountered many foes in battle.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
說起來，你是劍士吧？
看樣子已經身經百戰了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
You should consider changing jobs to a Knight. Come and talk to me if you are interested.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
不妨考慮轉職騎士。
有興趣的話，就來找我聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Please take
your time in
looking around.
Good day.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
請隨意參觀。
祝你愉快。

scripts.text:
Mmm?
{0},
what can I do for you?
Ah, you don't know
who to visit?
scripts.translation:
嗯？
{0}，有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？
啊，你不知道該找誰？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I believe the Knights in charge of testing have set an order in which you must visit them. I suppose it helps the testing process.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
負責考驗的騎士們安排了拜訪順序，你得依次去找他們。
這樣考驗也更容易進行吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First, go and visit
Sir Andrew for your first test. Don't be too nervous, he'll explain everything once you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
先去找安德魯爵士，接受第一項考驗。
別緊張，找他談談，他會詳細說明。

scripts.text: It appears that you have finished one test. Let's see. Sir Andrew, who must this Swordman visit next?
scripts.translation:
看來你已經完成了一項考驗。
讓我看看。
安德魯爵士，這位劍士接下來該找誰？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
I said to
visit Sir Siracuse.
Funny, I thought I told
you. Did I forget...?
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
我說的是去找西拉庫斯爵士。
奇怪，我記得說過啊。
難道忘了...？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Did you hear?
Go to Sir Siracuse and take his test. Once you complete his test, do not forget who you're supposed to visit next as well.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
聽到了吧？
去找西拉庫斯爵士，接受他的考驗。
完成後，記得問清楚接下來該找誰。

scripts.text:
Let's see...
You've completed two tests.
Sir Siracuse, who must this Swordman visit next?
scripts.translation:
讓我看看...
你已經完成兩項考驗了。
西拉庫斯爵士，這位劍士接下來該找誰？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Oh...!
Um, who was next...?
Right! Sir Windsor!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
噢...！
嗯，下一個是誰來著...？
對了！溫莎爵士！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Head over to
Sir Windsor Benedict for your next test. Listen carefully to the Knights in charge of testing so that you don't feel lost, alright?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
下一項考驗，去找溫莎·本尼迪克特爵士。
仔細聽考官們的指示，就不會摸不著頭緒了，好嗎？

scripts.text:
Sir Windor...?
Who must this
Swordman visit
next?
scripts.translation:
溫莎爵士...？
這位劍士接下來該找誰？

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
...Amy Beatrice.
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...艾米·貝阿特麗絲。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, go and visit
Lady Amy and take her test. Make sure you pay attention to who you must go to for your next test.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
啊，去找艾米女士，接受她的考驗。
要記清楚，下一項考驗該去找誰。

scripts.text:
Let's see...
Lady Amy, who
must this Swordman
visit next?
scripts.translation:
讓我看看...
艾米女士，這位劍士接下來該找誰？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh...
I said to visit
Sir Edmond!
Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哦...
我說的是去找埃德蒙爵士！
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Now, go and speak
to Sir Edmond. He will
be in charge of your
next test.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
現在去找埃德蒙爵士吧。
由他負責下一項考驗。

scripts.text:
Don't you only have to visit one more person? The Knight in
charge of the final test
is Sir Gray Prospheiro.
scripts.translation:
你應該只剩一位考官沒拜訪了吧？
最後一項考驗，由格雷·普羅斯佩羅爵士負責。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
This world operates according
to the law of cause and effect.
All will be revealed in the end.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
這個世界遵循因果法則。
一切終將水落石出。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Be alert and do
your best, as this
is the last test.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
這是最後一項考驗，打起精神，全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Return to me
after you have
completed the
final test.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
完成最後一項考驗，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
Finish the last test.
Once that is complete, all the Knights involved in your testing shall gather, and we will evaluate your performance.
scripts.translation:
去完成最後一項考驗吧。
完成後，負責考驗你的騎士們會齊聚一堂，評議你的表現。

scripts.text:
Oh...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return once you have distributed all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
哦...！
技能點還沒用完，就不能轉職。
把技能點全部分配好，再回來吧。

scripts.text:
Oh, have you completed all the tests? But not everyone who completes the tests can
become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
哦，所有考驗都完成了？
不過，並不是完成考驗就一定能成為騎士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
During the test we see how loyal, honorable and strong you are. We also see if you were courteous and if you know the value of modesty and reverence.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
考驗中，我們觀察你的忠誠、榮譽與實力，也看你是否有禮，是否懂得謙遜與敬重。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Through this process, I have also observed your actions. All seven of our opinions will be reflected in the decision of your job change.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
這段時間，我也一直留意著你的言行。
我們七個人的意見，將共同決定你能否轉職。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Then...
We shall listen
to everyone's thoughts!
Andrew, what do you think?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
那麼...
聽聽各位的意見吧！
安德魯，你怎麼看？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
What can I say?
I approve!
Having lived as
a Swordsman up
until now
is enough.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
還有什麼好說的？
我贊成！
能以劍士的身份一路走到現在，已經足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
This one has
gathered items
that are troublesome
to obtain. I approve!
I believe {0}he will continue to be loyal after becoming a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
這位收集齊了那些難以取得的物品。
我贊成！
我相信{0}，成為騎士後也會繼續保持忠誠。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Hmm.
What a nice review.
Siracuse, what are your thoughts?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
嗯，評價不錯。
西拉庫斯，你怎麼看？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Heh, very well. Not quite what
I would want, but hopefully will become better in the future.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
呵，還不錯。
雖然離我的期望還有些差距，但願今後能做得更好。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
After becoming a Knight, you must build a good reputation through honor. Ehh... I approve.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
成為騎士後，要以光榮的行為贏得好名聲。
嗯...我贊成。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Okay...
Windsor,
what about you?
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
好...
溫莎，你呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
....Approved.
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...贊成。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I don't think
he disapproves.
Then, let's listen
to Amy's opinion.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
看來他沒有異議。
那麼，聽聽艾米的意見。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~ He's so polite!
He'll grow to be a wonderful Knight. And he's got such cute widdle cheeeeks~ Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯~他真有禮貌！
一定會成為出色的騎士。
而且，那小臉蛋也太可愛了~
Hee hee!

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~ She should be great!
She's very courteous and also very cute, so a few more points! Heh~
I shouldn't be saying things like this!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯~她一定會很出色！
既有禮貌，又可愛，再加幾分！
Heh~
哎呀，我不該說這種話！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Well...
A strange review,
but I believe
she approves.
Edmond, speak
your mind.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
嗯...
評價有些奇怪，不過，看來她是贊成的。
埃德蒙，說說你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
He seems a little rough, but something bright shines within him. With polish and refinement, his true value will shine forth
as the sun.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
他還有些粗糙，但內心已有光芒。
經過磨鍊與雕琢，他真正的價值必將如太陽般閃耀。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
It's difficult to see, but there is a spiritual beauty within her. With polish and refinement, her true value will glow as resplendently
as the moon.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
雖然不易察覺，但她的心靈有著美好的光輝。
經過磨鍊與雕琢，她真正的價值必將如月亮般燦爛。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Lastly...
Gray. I would like
to hear your thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
最後...
格雷，我想聽聽你的意見。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
A young {0} coming here with the determination to become a Knight is enough...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
一位年輕的{0}，懷著成為騎士的決心來到這裡，這就足夠了...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Everyone
has approved.
No one has opposed.
Then I shall tell
you my opinion.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
各位都贊成，沒有人反對。
那麼，說說我的看法。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
My decision is...
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
我的決定是...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I approve.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
我贊成。

[Captain Herman]
You may not have finished all the tests perfectly, but you have all the necessary qualities to become
a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
雖然並非每項考驗都完成得完美，但你已具備成為騎士所需的全部素質。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I hereby declare
you a member of
the Prontera Chivalry.
Protect the weak and
live with honor.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
我在此宣佈，你正式成為普隆德拉騎士團的一員。
保護弱小，為榮譽而活。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...
We have prepared a small gift to congratulate you on your job change. Please use it when you are in battle as you honorably protect others.
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
哦...
我們準備了一份小禮物，祝賀你轉職。
當你為保護他人而光榮奮戰時，請使用它。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Go forth!
The future of
Rune-Midgarts
rests on your
shoulders!
scripts.translation:
[團長 赫爾曼]
出發吧！
盧恩·米德加茲的未來，就託付在你的肩上了！

little Novice.
Welcome to the
Prontera Chivalry.

[Sir Andrew]
We, the members of the
Prontera Chivalry, are putting our best effort in protecting peace in this world.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
我們普隆德拉騎士團的成員，正竭盡全力守護世界的和平。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Good day.
May I help you
with something?
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
日安。
有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Welcome back~
Did you gather
all the items?
Let's check and see...
scripts.translation:

歡迎回來~
東西都收集齊了嗎？
讓我檢查一下...

scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
有什麼要問我的嗎？
你該去接受下一項考驗了。
快去吧，西拉庫斯爵士正等著你~

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]

scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
所有考驗都完成了吧？
幹得好！
去找團長，我們好一起評議你的表現。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Did you have something you needed to ask me? You should go and take your next test. Do your best.
I know you can do it!
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
有什麼要問我的嗎？
去接受下一項考驗吧，全力以赴。
我相信你能做到！

[Sir Andrew]
You must work diligently to gather food as well as save zeny to buy equipment. Save everything you
find in battle, even the smallest Jellopy.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
要勤快地收集食物，也要攢下Zeny購買裝備。
戰鬥中得到的東西都留好，哪怕是一小塊傑勒比結晶。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
But it's not good
to be too greedy.
After all, we are Knights.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
但太貪婪也不好。
畢竟，我們是騎士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
You might that you're
weak right now, but someday
you'll become stronger.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
你也許覺得現在的自己很弱，但總有一天會變強。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Dream of a bright future, and go look forward on the path that you choose to take.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
心懷對美好未來的憧憬，在自己選擇的道路上不斷前行。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Even during the battles we face each and every day, we dream of
a bright future that is to come.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
即便每天都要面對戰鬥，我們也始終憧憬著美好的未來。

the Prontera Chivalry,
Andrew Shylock.

your first test.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
我是普隆德拉騎士團的騎士，安德魯·夏洛克。
由我負責你的第一項考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
I will be testing your sense of loyalty. Every Knight must possess this virtue. For this exam, you will be gathering prizes from
the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
我要考驗你的忠誠，這是每位騎士都應具備的美德。
這項考驗，需要你收集戰場上的戰利品。

mastered being
a Swordsman.
scripts.translation:

等等，你似乎已經把劍士的本領練到極致了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Impressive...!

I don't think your
loyalty needs to
be tested.
scripts.translation:

了不起...！
這樣看來，你的忠誠已經無需考驗了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Please go to my fellow Knight, Sir Siracuse, as he will give you your next test. Well done in mastering the Swordman job.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
去找我的同僚西拉庫斯爵士，接受下一項考驗吧。
能把劍士的本領練到極致，真是出色。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Without
further ado,
let's begin!
Go and gather the
following items...
scripts.translation:

不多說了，開始吧！
去收集以下物品...

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
I shall be
waiting here for
you to bring the
items I've listed.
See you soon~
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
我會在這裡等你把清單上的東西帶回來。
回頭見~

scripts.text:

Good day.
scripts.translation:

祝你愉快。

scripts.translation:

太好了！
辛苦你收集這些物品。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Please visit my fellow Knight, Sir Siracuse, and continue the tests with the dedication and loyalty you've shown to me this day.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
去找我的同僚西拉庫斯爵士吧。
帶著今天表現出的熱忱與忠誠，繼續接受考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Wait, wait...
I think you're
still missing some
items. In case you
forgot, let me
remind you...
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
等等...
好像還沒收集齊。
怕你忘了，我再說一遍...

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
Now, please take this test seriously and with sincerity.
Now, I'll be waiting for you
to complete this task.
scripts.translation:
[安德魯爵士]
請認真、誠心地對待這項考驗。
我會在這裡等你完成任務。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Hey there!
How are you doing?
The Chivalry's been
doing pretty well.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
嘿，你好嗎？
騎士團最近還不錯。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Oh?
What is a Novice
doing here?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
哦？
初心者來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Offense and defense.
Is there a way to have both without compromising one or the other?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
進攻與防守。
怎樣才能兼顧兩者，不必顧此失彼呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Eh?
Do you have
something to
ask me?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
嗯？
有什麼想問我的嗎？

Oh?

something to
ask me?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
哦？
有什麼想問我的嗎？

You again?

scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
又來了。
有什麼事嗎？
抱歉，我現在很忙。
先去完成剩下的考驗吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
We've been
testing new members,
but not all of them
show as much promise
as you.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
我們一直在考驗新成員，但不是人人都像你這麼有潛力。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
I hope these new recruits all behave themselves, and don't
bring shame to the Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
但願這些新人都能守規矩，別給騎士團丟臉。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
If you catch any of the new guys acting in a way unbecoming of a Knight, scold them for me please?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
如果看到新人做出有失騎士身份的事，替我訓斥他們幾句，好嗎？

scripts.translation:

想當騎士嗎？
初心者可不能直接轉職騎士。

becoming a Knight.

先成為經驗豐富的劍士，再考慮當騎士吧。

哦，想當騎士？

scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
來找我之前，得先去拜訪其他人。
在我看來，你還沒證明自己掌握了基本素質。

scripts.translation:

你不是該去接受安德魯的考驗嗎？

每項考驗都很重要。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
原來如此，你通過第一項考驗了。
好，我抽點時間給你。
先自我介紹一下，我叫詹姆斯·西拉庫斯。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

這項考驗，要看看你對騎士之道瞭解多少。

別緊張，不會耽擱你太久，只問幾個簡單的問題。
畢竟，你還要去找其他考官，對吧？

let's begin.

promptly.

scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
錯！
那是雙手劍！
真想當騎士嗎？
連基本知識都不懂...

scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
不懂的就去城裡找騎士請教。
申請轉職前，先多瞭解一下騎士！

scripts.translation:

好，接下來考考技能。
學習怪物互擊，不需要先學會以下哪項技能？

錯！
學習怪物互擊，必須先學會那個技能！
申請轉職前，先多瞭解一下騎士！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Knights can also use Spears, unlike other jobs, and have skills related to Spears as well. What skills are not necessary to learn the skill Brandish Spear?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
與其他職業不同，騎士還能使用長矛，並擁有相應的技能。
學習騎乘攻擊，不需要先學會以下哪項技能？

scripts.text: Pierce Lv.5
scripts.translation: 5級連刺攻擊

scripts.text: Spear Stab Lv.3
scripts.translation: 3級長矛刺擊

scripts.text: Spear Boomerang Lv.3
scripts.translation: 3級投擲長矛攻擊

scripts.text: Peco Peco Ride Lv.1
scripts.translation: 1級騎乘術

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong! You need to learn that to learn Brandish Spear! How can you not know about Knights if you want to become one?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
錯！
學習騎乘攻擊，必須先學會那個技能！
想當騎士，怎麼能不瞭解騎士呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
If you aren't sure about anything, go into town and ask any Knight
for help. Come back after you've learned more about Knights.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
不懂的就去城裡找騎士請教。
多瞭解一些騎士的知識，再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Some Spears also have magical attributes, just like spells. Of the following, which can attack a Nightmare, which has the Ghost attribute?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
有些長矛也像法術一樣，帶有魔法屬性。
以下哪把長矛能攻擊念屬性的夢魘？

scripts.text: Zephyrus
scripts.translation: 西風長矛

scripts.text: Lance
scripts.translation: 長槍

scripts.text: Bill Guisarme
scripts.translation: 修爾特長矛

scripts.text: Crescent Scythe
scripts.translation: 死神之鐮

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong! You'll be doing absolutely no damage with that type of Spear! Come back after you've learned more about Knights!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
錯！
那種長矛根本造成不了傷害！
多瞭解一些騎士的知識，再回來！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
If you have a question, just ask any Knight in town. This is basic knowledge for us!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
有問題就去城裡找騎士請教。
這些都是我們的基本知識！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
When you become a Knight you can ride a Peco Peco. However, your attack speed decreases once you're mounted on a Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
當了騎士，就能騎乘大嘴鳥。
不過，騎上大嘴鳥後，攻擊速度會下降。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
But, you can counter this speed decrease as you learn the Cavalier Mastery skill. What percentage of your normal attack speed will you have after learning Level 3 Cavalier Mastery?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
學習騎兵修煉，能抵消騎乘時的攻擊速度下降。
學到3級後，攻擊速度是正常速度的百分之多少？

scripts.text: 70 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻擊速度的70%

scripts.text: 80 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻擊速度的80%

scripts.text: 90 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻擊速度的90%

scripts.text: 100 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻擊速度的100%

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong!
Don't bother riding a Peco Peco if you don't know about Cavalier Mastery!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
錯！
連騎兵修煉都不瞭解，還騎什麼大嘴鳥！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You better come back after you've learned a little more about Knights!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
先去多瞭解一下騎士，再回來吧！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Good, good...
I'm pretty sure you know a decent amount about Knights. Now, let me ask you some personal questions about Knights.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
很好，很好...
看來你對騎士已經相當瞭解了。
接下來，問幾個關於騎士的問題，聽聽你個人的想法。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
What should you do when you run into a Novice asking for help in town?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
在城裡遇到求助的初心者，你該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Tell the Novice of a reasonable hunting area.
scripts.translation: 告訴初心者合適的狩獵地點

scripts.text: Let the Novice fight while you take the damage.
scripts.translation: 讓初心者戰鬥，自己承受傷害

scripts.text: Give the Novice a bunch of Zeny and items.
scripts.translation: 給初心者大量Zeny和物品

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Of course, even a Novice needs to learn how to be independent. Giving good guidance to Novices is one of the best things we can do.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
沒錯，初心者也得學會獨立。
給他們正確的指引，是我們能做的最好的幫助之一。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You have the wrong idea. Do you really believe that is helping the Novice? Give a man a fish, he will eat for a day. Teach him to fish, he will eat for a lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
想錯了。
你真覺得這樣是在幫初心者嗎？
授人以魚，不如授人以漁！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Do you really believe that this will truly help the poor Novice? It's generous but, they will not know the true value of zeny and items until they earn it themselves.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
你真覺得這樣能幫到那個可憐的初心者？
雖然慷慨，可只有靠自己掙來的Zeny和物品，才能讓他們明白其中的價值。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Alright...
Now, how should
you act within
a party?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
好...
那麼，在隊伍裡，你該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Protect everyone in the front of the battle.
scripts.translation: 站在戰鬥前線保護大家

scripts.text: Gather monsters and destroy them at once.
scripts.translation: 把魔物聚在一起，一舉消滅

scripts.text: Get as many items possible, at all cost.
scripts.translation: 不惜代價，儘可能多拿物品

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
That's it! Our strength and attacks are very important in a party. All Knights should engage in a battle with that mindset.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
沒錯！
在隊伍裡，我們的力量和攻擊很重要。
每位騎士都應抱著這種心態戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Are you crazy? Don't you realize the flaw in that kind of thinking? You can't control large mobs. What if they kill you? Who will protect the innocent?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
瘋了嗎？
沒想過這樣做有什麼問題？
魔物太多，你根本控制不住。
萬一你死了，誰來保護無辜的人？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
I see your greed and we will have none of it here! It seems you do not truly care for others!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
看得出你很貪婪，我們這裡容不下這種人！
你根本不關心別人！
滾！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Lastly...
what's the most
important value
a Knight must have?
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
最後...
騎士最重要的品質是什麼？

scripts.text: Honor
scripts.translation: 榮譽

scripts.text: Wealth
scripts.translation: 財富

scripts.text: Status
scripts.translation: 地位

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Right, above all else, Knights must be honorable! We live and die for honor! Always keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
對，騎士最重要的是守護榮譽！
我們為榮譽而生，為榮譽而死！
一定要銘記。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You're scum! You strive to become a Knight for personal wealth? Get lost! We will not accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
人渣！
想當騎士，只是為了發財？
滾！
騎士團不會接納你這種人！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
So you're trying to become famous through the Chivalry? That's pathetic. We won't accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
想借騎士團揚名？
真可悲。
我們不會接納你這種人！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Well then,
this is the
end of my test.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
好，我的考驗到此結束。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
For your next
test, please go
see Sir Windsor.
He's very quiet,
but don't let that
get to you.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
下一項考驗，去找溫莎爵士。
他不怎麼說話，別太在意。

scripts.translation: 我想參加轉職考驗

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

[Sir Siracuse]

You already took my test, didn't you? You're done here. You should go visit Sir Windsor now...
scripts.translation:

嘿...
你不是已經接受過我的考驗了嗎？
我這裡已經結束了，去找溫莎爵士吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Hmmm...?
Alright.
It's just that
you had that
look on your
face.
scripts.translation:
[西拉庫斯爵士]
嗯...？
好吧，只是你剛才那副表情讓我有些在意。

Well then,
go and see the
captain. We'll all
be there to evaluate
your performance.
scripts.translation:

好，去找團長吧。

outside.

...有問題？

scripts.translation: 考什麼？

scripts.translation: 怎麼參加考驗？

scripts.translation: 我想離開

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 沒有

...
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...

scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...與魔物戰鬥。

scripts.text:

...Kill them all.
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...把它們全部消滅。

scripts.text:

...
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...

...Three stages.
Beat them all.
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...三個階段。
全部通過。

scripts.text:

......3 minutes
for each stage.
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...每關3分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
..........

[Sir Windsor]
...Go in the
waiting room.
scripts.translation:

...去候考室。

will begin.

...Go talk to
Amy Beatrice now.
scripts.translation:
[溫莎爵士]
...去找艾米·貝阿特麗絲。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh...!
I wonder, why
have you come
to visit me?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哎呀...！
怎麼想到來看我呀？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww~
What a cute
little Novice!
Soooooo cute!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哇~
好可愛的小初心者！
真是太可愛了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Welcome to
the Prontera Chivalry~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
歡迎來到普隆德拉騎士團~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Ooh, you're
a Swordsman...?
Did you come to
change jobs to
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哦，你是劍士...？
來轉職騎士的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Hmmm?
Why did you
come to Amy?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯？
找艾米有什麼事呀？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
假設你是一名騎士，正在夢羅克找隊伍。
你會怎麼做呢？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Wow~
Now it's time for
everyone to decide
on your job change!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哇~
該由大家決定你能不能轉職了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You're not having
trouble as a Knight,
are you? Well, I think
you're doing well~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
當騎士沒遇到什麼困難吧？
我覺得你做得很好呢~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Of course~
You're a member of
the Prontera Chivalry~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
那當然~
你可是普隆德拉騎士團的一員~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Heh heh...
Are you interested
in becoming a Knight
later on? You'd be
a great Knight~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
Heh heh...
以後想當騎士嗎？
你一定會是個很棒的騎士~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Remember, you're
going to be a Knight,
alright? Promise?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
說好了，以後要當騎士哦？
答應我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
We're only Knights,
but hope you enjoy
your stay here.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我們雖只是騎士，也希望你在這裡待得開心。
Heh heh~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
To apply, talk
to the captain
all the way over
there. Hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
想申請的話，去那邊找團長吧。
Hee hee~

scripts.translation: 我想參加轉職考驗

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~

scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯~
你申請轉職了！
好呀，有這份決心，很快就能當上騎士！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But...
You have to go
to the other Knights
before talking to Amy.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
不過...
來找艾米之前，要先去找其他騎士。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'd love to test
you from the beginning,
but I'm not allowed to.
Hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我也想從一開始就考驗你，可惜不允許呢。
Hee hee~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww~
Alright...
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哎呀~
好吧...

scripts.text: Sir Windsor told me to--
scripts.translation: 溫莎爵士讓我來--

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh!
No need to say
anything more.
Welcome! It's time
to take Amy's test!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哦！
不用再說了。
歡迎！
該接受艾米的考驗了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]

a proud Lady Knight of the Prontera Chivalry. Amy's test will test your etiquette as a Knight~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我叫艾米·貝阿特麗絲，是普隆德拉騎士團引以為榮的女騎士。
艾米要考考你身為騎士的禮儀~

[Lady Amy]

scripts.translation:

我會根據你的回答，判斷你是否懂得禮儀。

scripts.text:

and answer as if you're
already a Knight, okay?
scripts.translation:

仔細聽，把自己當成真正的騎士來回答，好嗎？

let's begin!

那麼，開始吧！

[Lady Amy]

Alright~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哎呀...
好吧~

Mmm~?
Have you learned
what you did wrong
last time? If you
fail again, I'm going
to be mad!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯~？
明白上次錯在哪裡了嗎？
再不通過，我可要生氣了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
So listen carefully
and answer as if you
are a Knight.
Well then,
let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
仔細聽，把自己當成騎士來回答。
好，開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
假設你是一名騎士，正在夢羅克找隊伍。
你會怎麼做呢？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww...
Alright~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哎呀...
好吧~

scripts.text:
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
假設你是一名騎士，正在夢羅克找隊伍。
你會怎麼做呢？

scripts.text: Shout out that you are looking for a party.
scripts.translation: 大聲喊話，表示自己在找隊伍

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
scripts.translation: 開聊天室等待

scripts.text: Look for people seeking Knights.
scripts.translation: 找正在招募騎士的人

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You have formed a party with equal leveled players. There's a Priest, a Wizard, a Hunter, an Assassin, and a Blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你和等級相近的玩家組成了隊伍。
隊裡有牧師、巫師、獵人、刺客和鐵匠...

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
The six of you decide to go hunt and have decided to go to the Pyramids.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你們六人決定一起狩獵，目的地是金字塔。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You reach Level 4
of the Pyramids
with your party.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你和隊友到了金字塔第4層。
你該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Check out the area and plan ahead.
scripts.translation: 觀察周圍，提前制定計劃

scripts.text: Gather monsters for your party members.
scripts.translation: 替隊友聚集魔物

scripts.text: Lead the party slowly at the front.
scripts.translation: 走在前方，帶隊緩慢前進

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But some rude players came with a group of monsters and disappeared! What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
這時，幾個沒禮貌的玩家引來一群魔物，自己卻消失了！
你該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Keep the monsters from reaching the party.
scripts.translation: 阻止魔物靠近隊伍

scripts.text: Defend while the party retreats.
scripts.translation: 掩護隊伍撤退

scripts.text: Run away on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation: 騎著大嘴鳥逃跑

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Luckily, you all lived through the crisis. But as you walk, you find a person, who is not in your party, collapsed on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
幸好，大家平安度過了危機。
繼續前進時，你們發現一個不屬於隊伍的人倒在地上。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
The person is asking politely for help. What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
那個人禮貌地向你們求助。
你該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Ask your party's Priest to help.
scripts.translation: 請隊裡的牧師幫忙

scripts.text: Say you will help for Zeny.
scripts.translation: 表示可以幫忙，但要收Zeny

scripts.text: Ignore and move on.
scripts.translation: 不理會，繼續前進

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You must bid farewell to your party members because you must go somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你要去別的地方，只好向隊友告別。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But you find
a rare item during
the battle. What
should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
不過，戰鬥時你得到了一件稀有物品。
你該怎麼處理？

scripts.text: Give it to who deserves it the most.
scripts.translation: 給最應得的人

scripts.text: Pretend like nothing happened and keep it.
scripts.translation: 假裝什麼都沒發生，自己留下

scripts.text: Decide with party who gets it.
scripts.translation: 和隊友商量歸誰

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You end up with the item and you go to Prontera to sell it. There are many people with shops and chat rooms opened selling items.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
最後，物品歸了你。
你去普隆德拉賣掉它，那裡有很多人開著商店或聊天室出售物品。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
What should you
do to sell your item?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
想賣掉這件物品，你該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Shout out loud to everyone.
scripts.translation: 向所有人大聲喊話

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
scripts.translation: 開聊天室等待

scripts.text: Inquire if there is anyone that is interested.
scripts.translation: 詢問有沒有人感興趣

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
While you are waiting,
someone comes and begs
for items and zeny.
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
等待時，有人來向你討要物品和Zeny。
你會怎麼做？

scripts.text: Give them some Zeny and items.
scripts.translation: 給對方一些Zeny和物品

scripts.text: Simply ignore them.
scripts.translation: 直接不理會

scripts.text: Give suggestions for a place to hunt.
scripts.translation: 推薦合適的狩獵地點

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Now you decide to go to the Hidden Temple by yourself. You happily ride on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
接著，你決定獨自去隱藏神殿，開心地騎著大嘴鳥出發了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But you run into
someone that is lost.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
不過，你遇到一個迷路的人。
你該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Tell the person how to reach the exit.
scripts.translation: 告訴對方怎麼去出口

scripts.text: Lead the person to the exit.
scripts.translation: 帶對方去出口

scripts.text: Give a Butterfly Wing.
scripts.translation: 給對方一個蝴蝶翅膀

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You've been hunting for a while, and now you're low on HP!
It's red now, which is very dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
狩獵了一陣後，你的HP已經很低了！
HP變成紅色，非常危險。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Ah, then a Priest
happens to walk by.
How would you ask
the Priest for a Heal?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
這時，恰好有位牧師路過。
你會怎麼請對方施展治癒術？

scripts.text: Would it be possible to get a heal please?
scripts.translation: 請問可以麻煩您幫我治療一下嗎？

scripts.text: Can I have a heal?
scripts.translation: 能給我治療一下嗎？

scripts.text: Heal plz!!
scripts.translation: 求治療！！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are now very
exhausted and it's time
to go back to town.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
現在你已經很累，該回城了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You then find
a rare item on
the street.
What should
you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
這時，你在路上發現一件稀有物品。
你該怎麼做？

scripts.text: Pick it up and keep it.
scripts.translation: 撿起來，自己留下

scripts.text: Ask around to find the owner.
scripts.translation: 四處打聽，尋找失主

scripts.text: Simply walk by.
scripts.translation: 直接走過去

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Okay,
that was the
end of my test!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
好了，我的考驗結束！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Well done, that kind of mentality is needed for a Knight! For your next test, visit Sir Edmond, please~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
做得好，騎士就該有這樣的心態！
下一項考驗，去找埃德蒙爵士吧~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Well, it wasn't perfect,
but I think you know enough
about etiquette to be
a fine Knight.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯，雖然不是十全十美，但你已經懂得足夠的禮儀，能成為出色的騎士了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm...
To be honest, I don't think your attitude is good enough to be a Knight quite yet.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯...
說實話，你現在的態度，還不太適合當騎士。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'll have nice comments about you for the captain. Do well on the tests you have left, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我會在團長面前好好誇誇你。
剩下的考驗也要好好表現哦？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Now, it's time for you to go to Sir Edmond for your next test. Do well on the rest of your tests. You better promise~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
現在去找埃德蒙爵士，接受下一項考驗吧。
後面的考驗也要好好表現，答應我哦~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
If you really act like that, everyone will think Knights are rude! Think about how you answered my questions and come again later.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
真要那樣做，大家都會覺得騎士沒禮貌！
好好想想剛才的回答，過會兒再來。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
If you want,
I'll let you
retake the test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你願意的話，我可以讓你再考一次，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You have to go to
Sir Edmond for your
next test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
下一項考驗，要去找埃德蒙爵士，記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Let's go talk to our
captain. Don't worry
too much. It should
be okay.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
去找團長談談吧。
別太擔心，應該沒問題的。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You still have
other tests to take.
Hurry and finish~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
還有其他考驗沒完成呢。
快去吧~

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Think of your
mind as if it were
flowing water.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
試著讓心如流水。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Trees with deep roots don't sway with the wind. The fact that powerful skills must be built on strong basics is immutable...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
根深的樹，不會隨風搖擺。
強大的技藝必須建立在牢固的基礎上，這是不變的道理...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Everything in this world exists in harmony. Living without disrupting this harmony is the right way to live...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
世間萬物和諧共存。
順應這份和諧，而不破壞它，才是正確的生存之道...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Those with ominous thoughts will only dream such dreams. It's better to have no dreams at all than to have dreams of sadness and despair.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
心懷不祥之念，夢中也只有不祥。
與其夢見悲傷和絕望，不如無夢。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
What is it...
Wandering Swordman?
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
有什麼事嗎...
流浪的劍士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
What is it...
Wandering Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
有什麼事嗎...
流浪的劍士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
I have seen your character for myself. It is now time for you to take the last test. Go and speak
to Sir Gray...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
我已親眼見識你的品行。
該接受最後一項考驗了，去找格雷爵士吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Go and speak
to our captain.
The time has come
for all of us to
evaluate your
performance.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
去找團長吧。
該由我們一起評議你的表現了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Flowing water
avoids obstacles,
going on its way...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
流水繞過阻礙，繼續前行...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Knights must be
able to pass things,
like calm water, in
any situation.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
騎士也應如平靜的流水，無論身處何境，都能從容應對。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Your future
can even be
decided now...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你的未來，也許此刻就能決定...

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想參加轉職考驗

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
A seed must first be nestled
in the earth before the seed may sprout. Then, the sprout must grow leaves before its buds blossom into flowers...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
種子先埋入土中，才能萌芽。
嫩芽先長出葉子，花蕾才能綻放...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
If not...
The flower will
be incomplete.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
否則...
花朵便不完整。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Go to the others
first, so that you
may find your path...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
先去找其他人，才能尋到自己的道路...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life that you
want will soon be
before your eyes.
Everything will
come in perfect
order.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你期盼的生活，很快就會展現在眼前。
一切自有先後。

scripts.text: Lady Amy sent me.
scripts.translation: 艾米女士讓我來的

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
It is now time to take my test. Please do your best, as you have done on the other tests.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
現在，該接受我的考驗了。
像之前一樣，全力以赴吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
My name is
Edmond Groster.
I am a member of
the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
我叫埃德蒙·格羅斯特，是普隆德拉騎士團的一員。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Knights are in the position for others to follow. Therefore, you must modestly think about the world's order and have the personality to fit the role you will play.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
騎士是他人追隨的榜樣。
因此，你應謙遜地思考世間的秩序，修養與身份相稱的品格。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You must not make careless decisions. Your will should bend as the reeds or be as firm as stone when the situation calls for it.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
不可草率決斷。
應變通時，如蘆葦般柔韌；應堅持時，如磐石般堅定。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You must not kill monsters without reason and not take joy in doing so. Take this time to quietly think about this on your own...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
不可無故殺戮魔物，更不可引以為樂。
趁這段時間，獨自靜心思考吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Then, we shall
begin the test.
Keep in mind
the quality of
reverence.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
那麼，開始考驗。
切記，心懷敬畏。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life you want
will soon be before
your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你期盼的生活，很快就會展現在眼前。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不是故意的...

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You were too careless in the last test. A Knight's sword exists to protect others, not to torment weaker monsters.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
上次考驗，你太草率了。
騎士的劍，是為了保護他人，不是為了欺凌弱小的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
In a world where everything exists in harmony, you can't have humans continuously destroying without purpose. This principle applies to the real world, not to this test alone.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
世間萬物和諧共存，人類不可無休止地肆意破壞。
這個道理，不只適用於考驗，也適用於現實。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The test
shall begin.
Show me your
patience...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
考驗開始。
讓我看看你的耐心...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life that you
want will soon be
before your eyes.
Everything will
come in perfect
order.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你期盼的生活，很快就會展現在眼前。
一切自有先後。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The glint of light
that shines off this blade cannot be put into words. This is the weapon every Knight must have.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
這劍刃映出的光芒，實在難以言喻。
每位騎士都該擁有這樣的武器。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Believe it
or not, I was
once a Novice
as well.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
信不信由你，我也曾是初心者。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Young one,
use your time
wisely.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
年輕人，要善用時間。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh...
A young Swordman.
Yes, what can
I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦...
年輕的劍士。
有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, you again.
What brings you
to me?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，又是你。
有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
To become stronger, you say?
Yes, Knights are indeed strong.
But why gain strength?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[格雷爵士]
想變得更強，是嗎？
沒錯，騎士確實強大。
但你為什麼要追求力量？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[格雷爵士]
啊，為了幫助公會，也可能是隊伍。
英明仁慈的特里斯拉姆三世國王，曾賜予我們這樣一句金玉良言...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
Satisfaction, you say.
It seems like you are
already a fine Swordman.
Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[格雷爵士]
為了滿足自己，是嗎？
你似乎已經是個出色的劍士了。
有什麼特別的理由，讓你想當騎士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
I understand your thoughts,
but there are those who wish to
become Knights without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[格雷爵士]
我理解你的想法。
不過，有些人想當騎士，卻從未認真想過原因。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I told you
to go to
the captain.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我說過，去找團長。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh...
A young Swordman.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦...
年輕的劍士。
有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Yes...
^3355FFClaymore^000000!
Every Knight
would want one!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
沒錯...
^3355FF雙手劍^000000！
每位騎士都會想要一把！

scripts.text: About ^3355FFClaymore^000000
Buy Claymore
scripts.translation: 購買雙手劍

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Claymore, one of the best among the famous swords you can attain in Rune-Midgarts' Prontera!! Its value is priceless when considered by a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
雙手劍，是盧恩·米德加茲王國普隆德拉能買到的名劍中最出色的幾把之一！
對騎士而言，它可是無價之寶。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Now, the Prontera Chivalry is making these fabulous Claymores. For Knights, they are only ^3355FF74,000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
如今，普隆德拉騎士團正在打造這些精美的雙手劍。
騎士購買，只要^3355FF74,000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
But not only that, you need
1 ^3355FFSteel^000000 because of the Claymore's characteristics. If you like, I can create one for you. For the honor of the Prontera Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
不過，由於雙手劍的特性，還需要1個^3355FF鋼鐵^000000。
願意的話，我可以替你打造一把。
為了普隆德拉騎士團的榮譽！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no...
It seems that you are carrying too many things. You don't have enough space for a heavy Claymore in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哎呀...
你帶的東西太多，背包裝不下沉重的雙手劍了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Why don't you
go and organize
your items first.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
先去整理一下物品吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
You are ready!
You must know the
true value of
a Claymore!
I shall make
it right now!!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
都準備好了！
看來你很懂雙手劍的真正價值！
我現在就打造！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The basics of
making the Claymore
is easy. Watch~!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
打造雙手劍的基本步驟很簡單。
看好了~！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Stir Stir*^000000
^3355FF*Ooncha Ooncha*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*Stir Stir*^000000
^3355FF*Ooncha Ooncha*^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Okay, it's ready!
Every Knight's pride:
a fine ^3355FFClaymore^000000.
You attained a reliable item.
It'll be a good companion on your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
好，完成了！
精美的^3355FF雙手劍^000000，每位騎士的驕傲。
這把武器值得信賴，會成為你冒險時的好夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I realize you may really want a Claymore, but I can't make it without the materials.
^3355FF74,000 zeny^000000 and ^3355FF1 Steel!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我知道你很想要雙手劍，可沒有材料，我也造不出來。
需要^3355FF74,000 Zeny^000000和^3355FF1個鋼鐵！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Come back when
you have everything
ready. I shall be
waiting...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
準備齊全再來吧。
我會在這裡等你...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Any Knight should be able to wield a Claymore as if it were an extension of their body. I used to look forward to brandishing my Claymore in battle...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
騎士應該把雙手劍使得如同自己的手腳一般。
我以前也總盼著在戰場上揮舞雙手劍...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I never really planned to become a Knight, but I did decide to become a strong person. Somehow, along my journeys, I ended up joining the Prontera Chivalry. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我原本沒打算當騎士，只是想成為強者。
不知不覺，旅途中就加入了普隆德拉騎士團。
Ha ha ha!

scripts.text:
Young one,
use your time
wisely.
scripts.translation: 年輕人，要善用時間。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
No point in
harboring regret
once time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
時光一去不返，後悔也無濟於事。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
No point in
harboring regret
once time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
時光一去不返，後悔也無濟於事。

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想參加轉職考驗

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Hoho, I see.
So you took
everyone else's
test?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
Hoho,
我明白了。
其他人的考驗都參加過了？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then shall
we begin mine?
It's not really
a test though.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那麼，開始我的考驗吧？
不過，其實也算不上考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Let's talk
casually,
shall we?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我們隨意聊聊，如何？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
First...
Why did you
decide to become
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
先說說...
你為什麼決定當騎士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
保重！

scripts.text: I've been thinking a lot.
scripts.translation: 我認真想過了

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Is that so...
I wonder if you
truly have...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
是嗎...
不知道你是否真的想過...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then...
Like last time,
I will ask again...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那麼，和上次一樣，我再問一遍...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
First...
Why did you
decide to become
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
先說說...
你為什麼決定當騎士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
Health is
every man's
treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
保重！
健康是每個人最寶貴的財富！

scripts.text: To become stronger...
scripts.translation: 為了變得更強...

scripts.text: To help my guild...
scripts.translation: 為了幫助我的公會...

scripts.text: Because I'm unsatisfied with myself right now...
scripts.translation: 因為我不滿現在的自己...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
To become stronger, you say?
Yes, Knights are indeed strong.
But why gain strength?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
想變得更強，是嗎？
沒錯，騎士確實強大。
但你為什麼要追求力量？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Is it to show off to others? To attain fame? Or do you have a diferent reason? What do you think is so good about gaining strength as a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
為了向別人炫耀？
為了揚名？
還是另有原因？
你認為獲得騎士的力量，有什麼好處？

scripts.text: Gain wealth and fame.
scripts.translation: 獲得財富和名聲

scripts.text: I can protect myself.
scripts.translation: 能保護自己

scripts.text: I can protect others.
scripts.translation: 能保護他人

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Of course, wealth and fame have their place in the world. But we as Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
當然，財富與名聲自有其價值。
但身為騎士，我們應為更高尚的美德而活。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Good thinking. You must first be able to protect yourself in order to protect others. To this end, you must constantly train, and never give in to laziness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
想得好。
先能保護自己，才能保護別人。
因此，必須勤加訓練，絕不懈怠。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，想得很好。
騎士的力量，應該用來保護弱小、捍衛正義。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
令人遺憾的是，有些騎士忘記了騎士道的基本準則，令我們蒙羞...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，為了幫助公會，也可能是隊伍。
英明仁慈的特里斯拉姆三世國王，曾賜予我們這樣一句金玉良言...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
^8B7500Beyond the calm river, lies a dangerous waterfall. Therefore, you must always be prepared for everything...^000000
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
^8B7500平靜河流的前方，也可能有危險的瀑布。
因此，凡事都應時刻做好準備...^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
So how do you
think you can
help your guild?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那麼，你認為自己能怎樣幫助公會？

scripts.text: My guild needs me.
scripts.translation: 公會需要我

scripts.text: I can help gather funds for my guild.
scripts.translation: 我能為公會籌集資金

scripts.text: I can protect my guild members.
scripts.translation: 我能保護公會成員

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Anyone, anywhere in this world,
has a place where they are needed. Never neglect someone in need, even if he is not a guild member.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
世上的每個人，都有需要自己的地方。
不要忽視求助的人，即使對方不是公會成員。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Of course wealth is important.
But we Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
財富當然重要。
但身為騎士，我們應為更高尚的美德而活。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，想得很好。
騎士的力量，應該用來保護弱小、捍衛正義。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
令人遺憾的是，有些騎士忘記了騎士道的基本準則，令我們蒙羞...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Satisfaction, you say.
It seems like you are
already a fine Swordman.
Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
為了滿足自己，是嗎？
你似乎已經是個出色的劍士了。
有什麼特別的理由，讓你想當騎士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I don't know about
Swordmen, but Knights do not allow self-indulgence. There are those so obsessed with gaining strength that they cannot control themselves.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
劍士如何，我不清楚，但騎士絕不能放縱自己。
有人執迷於追求力量，甚至失去了自制。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
So...
What part of yourself
are you not satisfied
with right now?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那麼...
現在，你對自己的哪方面不滿意？

scripts.text: Skills.
scripts.translation: 技能

scripts.text: Goal.
scripts.translation: 目標

scripts.text: Appearance.
scripts.translation: 外表

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Skill is something you gain with experience as a Knight. It cannot be your highest goal. Otherwise, you'll never be satisfied as a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
當了騎士，技藝自然會隨著經驗增長。
它不該是你最高的目標。
否則，即使成了騎士，你也永遠不會滿足。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I see...
Always having a goal is very important. You may be full of ideas upon becoming a Knight, but that may change with time.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我明白了...
始終有個目標，非常重要。
剛當上騎士時，你也許有許多想法，不過，它們也會隨著時間改變。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no...
What you see isn't what really counts. A Swordman may be stronger than a Knight, and even Knight may grow weak if he becomes lazy.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦，不...
眼睛看到的，並非真正重要的東西。
劍士也可能比騎士強，騎士一旦懈怠，也會變得弱小。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I understand your thoughts,
but there are those who wish to
become Knights without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我理解你的想法。
不過，有些人想當騎士，卻從未認真想過原因。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Those are the ones who instigate problems and shame the honor of Knights, bringing irreversible results.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
正是這種人惹是生非，玷汙騎士的榮譽，釀成無法挽回的後果。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The same goes for you as well. Once you become a Knight, you can never become a Swordman again. The duties and responsibilities of a Knight will always be with you.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
你也一樣。
一旦成了騎士，就不能再變回劍士。
騎士的職責與責任，將始終伴隨你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you become a Knight right away, what are you going to do first?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
如果現在就成為騎士，你會先做什麼？

scripts.text: I am going to go straight to battle.
scripts.translation: 立刻投入戰鬥

scripts.text: There are those waiting for me.
scripts.translation: 有人在等我

scripts.text: I will learn more about Knights.
scripts.translation: 進一步瞭解騎士

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Battle...?
And then?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
戰鬥...？
然後呢？

scripts.text: I will grow within a short period of time.
scripts.translation: 儘快成長

scripts.text: I would like to test my ability as a Knight.
scripts.translation: 檢驗自己身為騎士的能力

scripts.text: I would like to go to more challenging places.
scripts.translation: 去更有挑戰性的地方

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't be in too much of a hurry to become strong. Even if you become
a Knight, you are still yourself.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
別急於變強。
即使當了騎士，你也還是原來的你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Testing yourself is a good thing. It's okay to be happy about how you change, but don't forget about the true qualities of being a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
檢驗自己是件好事。
為自身的變化高興，也無妨，但別忘了騎士應有的品格。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Even if you become a Knight, you are not changing your inner self. No need to overwork yourself.
Relax and take things step by step.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
成為騎士，並不會讓你內在的自己改變。
不必過分勉強，放鬆些，一步一步來。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Who is
waiting for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
誰在等你？

scripts.text: My friends.
scripts.translation: 我的朋友

scripts.text: My Guild members.
scripts.translation: 我的公會同伴

scripts.text: My Lover.
scripts.translation: 我的戀人

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I see, they would share in the joy of your achievements. Don't ever lose your kind heart, and always give help to your friends.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我明白了，他們會為你的成就一同歡喜。
要始終心懷善意，幫助朋友。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Those who would share in your happiness and hardship. As a Knight, you must always protect them.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
與你同甘共苦的人。
身為騎士，你應始終保護他們。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh, youth!
Becoming a Knight
for your beloved!
Always protect {0}...
Even at the sacrifice
of your own life!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦，青春啊！
為了摯愛成為騎士！
要始終保護{0}...
哪怕犧牲自己的生命！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Also...
Love them forever.
Sincere affection
is hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
還有...
永遠愛著對方。
真摯的感情，難能可貴。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Good attitude...
What do you plan
on learning?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
態度不錯...
你打算了解什麼？

scripts.text: Comfortable places for Knights to go...
scripts.translation: 適合騎士去的舒適地方...

scripts.text: The different paths of a Knight...
scripts.translation: 騎士的不同道路...

scripts.text: Ways to get more money as a Knight...
scripts.translation: 騎士賺更多錢的方法...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
There are many places that are comfortable or uncomfortable in this world. However Knights must
be able to survive anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
世上有舒適的地方，也有艱苦的地方。
但騎士必須能在任何地方生存。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
There are many similar Knights outside in the world. Think of them as your seniors and ask many questions.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
外面還有許多和你一樣的騎士。
把他們當作前輩，多多請教。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no. Do you hold wealth as a priority of being a Knight? We're not meant to be that way. Come again when you have thought
more about it...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦，不。
你把發財當成騎士的首要目標？
我們不該如此。
好好想想，再回來吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no, we've been
talking too much...
I apologize for
keeping you here
for so long.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哎呀，我們聊得太久了...
抱歉，讓你在這裡耽擱了這麼久。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed talking with you. You remind me of myself as a young recruit. Shall we talk to the captain and decide on your
job change?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你聊得很愉快。
你讓我想起年輕時剛入團的自己。
去找團長，決定你能否轉職吧？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't worry too
much, I have a very
high opinion of you.
Now, go~
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
別太擔心，我對你的評價很高。
去吧~

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed speaking with you. You can think about the principles of Knighthood more once you become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你交談很愉快。
成為騎士後，還可以繼續思考騎士之道。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then, shall we go to the captain and decide on your job change? Don't worry too much. You are good enough to be a Knight!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那麼，去找團長，決定你能否轉職吧？
別太擔心，你已經具備騎士的資格！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed talking with you. Although, there were some
things that bothered me...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你聊得很愉快。
不過，有些地方還是讓我有些在意...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
You should go
to the captain
so we can decide
on your job change.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
去找團長吧，我們好決定你能否轉職。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't worry too much, coming to take my test means the others have acknowledged you as well.
Go now...!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
別太擔心，能來接受我的考驗，說明其他人也認可了你。
去吧...！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Conversing
with young ones
is always enjoyable...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和年輕人交談，總是令人愉快...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
But it seems as though your dream is elsewhere, or that your focus is hazy. Spend more time as a Swordman, and come back
to me later.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
不過，你似乎另有所求，或是目標還不明確。
再以劍士的身份磨鍊一段時間，之後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you truly wish to become a Knight, you must change your outlook first. Then, we shall see.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
真想當騎士，就得先改變想法。
之後，再看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Everyone will
carefully make
their decision,
so go now!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
各位都會慎重決定，去吧！

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想參加轉職考驗

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Hoho~
There are many
other younger
Knights in here.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
Hoho~
這裡還有許多年輕的騎士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you talk
to all of them,
I may review
you as well.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
先去和他們一一談談，也許我會重新評價你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
Health is
every man's
treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
保重！
健康是每個人最寶貴的財富！
